stage.description: Kerno deterministic backend/API scenario validation against the running slot

artifacts.description: Per-endpoint run responses, aggregated verdicts, and copied Kerno report.json files

nextSteps: kerno init                       # bind the single Kerno agent to THIS worktree
Ask your Kerno agent to generate a scenario suite (or ensure .kerno/scenarios/ is committed)
./.har/launch.sh 1               # then start your app in the slot
Open .har/artifacts/backend-validation/ for verdicts and per-endpoint run responses
